scientific_integrity: The previously established even-cube strong odd chromatic number is not claimed as novel. Same mathematical model proof and completeness checks only; no independent review.
scientific_limitations: Full exact optimum-coloring census only for the four-cube; the even-dimensional extension is existence only. Fixed-size census relies on inspectable exhaustive finite code. Priority to equivalent unindexed material remains uncertain.
title: Nonlinear optimal strong odd colorings of hypercubes: a four-cube census and even-dimensional persistence
